==Description==
The '''Snow Golem''' was the fifth enemy that spawned in [[Krampus Frosthold]], as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a high amount of health for its debut, though it was quite slow. It also had the freeze immunity, meaning that it could not be frozen or slowed down by freezing towers. On later waves, the '''Snow Golem''' could spawn as a hidden enemy.

The '''Snow Golem''' had one ability where upon death, it would spawn three [[Snowman (Krampus Frosthold)|Snowmen]], which have slightly less health combined than it but are faster. The '''Snow Golem''' could also be spawned by the [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability.

==Appearance==
The '''Snow Golem''' was a humanoid with elongated, straight arms, a cylindrical head and a hunched back. It had two pebbles for eyes, a carrot for a nose and a stick which resembles a unibrow. On its torso it had three black pebbles that resemble buttons, with multiple sticks poking out of its back.

==Strategy==
*As the '''Snow Golem''' spawns [[Snowman (Krampus Frosthold)|Snowmen]] upon death, area of effect towers such as the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Pursuit]] can be very useful here.
*High DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Minigunner]] can be very useful against this, due to its high health.
*While this has [[Freeze Immunity]], due to its slow speed it is generally not necessary to slow it down.
